summary.text: Robert Allain is a Republican member of the Louisiana Senate, representing District 21 (Assumption, Iberia, Lafourche, St. Martin, St. Mary and Terrebonne parishes), and was elected in 2023, according to the official Senate member page. Robert Allain is vice chair of the Commerce, Consumer Protection and International Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: The page lists committee assignments including Commerce, Consumer Protection and International Affairs (vice chair), Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development, Natural Resources, Revenue and Fiscal Affairs, Insurance (interim member), the Atchafalaya Basin Program Oversight Committee and the Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay, and caucus affiliations including the Acadiana Delegation.
